comment:
the big risk of this forward/backward transformation is now that at the dst changes hour, the calculation is wrong: during dst change the same local date time exists 2 times. when you convert the instant to a local time (after local time went backwards due to dst change) and then you convert the local time back, you're off by an hour.
the correct way here is to just call toepochmillies(). please do not convert forward backwards from to/local time.
